tr.title: XRP Nasdaq Yolunda, Madenciler Rallide: Kripto Piyasasinda Son 24 Saat
tr.body:
Evernorth, Ripple destekli XRP hazine sirketi olarak SPAC Armada ile birlesme yolunda son engeli asti. ABD Menkul Kiymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu (SEC) S-4 kayit beyanini onayladi; hisse sahipleri 30 Eylul'de oy kullanacak ve sirket XRPN ticker'i ile Nasdaq'ta islem gormeye baslayacak. Yatirimcilarin onaylamasi durumunda Evernorth, halka acik bir XRP hazine aracina donusecek ve $XRP piyasasinda yeni bir kurumsal talep kanali olusacak. Sirkete 233 milyon dolarlik bir deger dusuklugu kaydedildigi, ancak bunun yapisal bir sorun olarak degerlendirilmedigi bildirildi.

Madencilik sektorunde ise sert bir ralli yasandi. Bitcoin'in 62 bin dolardan 80 bin dolara yukselisi, sektor hisselerini asiri reaktif hale getirdi. Canaan, American Bitcoin ve Cango uc ayda yuzde 67'ye varan oranlarda deger kazandi. Bitcoin'in 23%'luk hareketi madencileri yil basindaki AI odakli kayiplardan sonra toparladi ve BTC pozisyonunun AI hikayesine ragmen hâlâ birincil kaldirac oldugunu gosterdi. $BTC hacim endeksi, opsiyon vadesi sonrasi yeniden pozisyonlanma isareti veriyor.

Gvenlik cephesinde The Sandbox, 700 bin dolarlik kopru acigini 1:1 olarak telafi edecegini duyurdu. Base ve BNB Chain uzerindeki uygun SAND sahipleri, projenin hazinesinden Ethereum tabanli SAND alacak; talep surreci iki hafta icinde acilacak. Ayni saatlerde OneKey, eski surum Ledger Ethereum uygulamasinda bir islem degistirme saldirisini laboratuvar ortaminda yeniden urettigini acikladi. Ledger, aciklamaya gore hatayi 1.22.2 surumunde coktan duzeltmisti ve herhangi bir kullanici fonu kaybi yasanmadi.

Makro tarafta Kevin Warsh'in Jackson Hole konusmasi, Treasury geri alim programi ve Fed politikasina iliskin sinyaller nedeniyle Bitcoin ve altin yatirimcilarinin radarinda. Warsh'in aciklamalari, uzun vadeli ABD getirileri ve risk varliklari icin yon gosterici olarak okunuyor. $ETH ve SOL da gun icinde minor primle islem gorurken piyasa genelinde hacim artti.

Binance kurucusu Changpeng Zhao, Bitcoin Asia 2026'da yaptigi konusmada Bitcoin'in bir sonraki yuksek volatil doneminde altini gecebilecegini soyledi ve stabil kointlerin yapay zeka entegrasyonunda onde gelen arac oldugunu vurguladi. Bu acidan bakildiginda, XRP hazine sirketinin kurumsal yatirimci kapsamini genisletme potansiyeli, madencilik hisselerinin yeni bir fiyat kesfi icin zemini hazirlamasi ve Jackson Hole sonrasi makro yonun yakindan takip edilmesi onceki onemli katalizorler olarak one cikiyor.

en.title: XRP Heads to Nasdaq, Miners Rebound: 24 Hours in Crypto
en.body:
Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, cleared the final regulatory hurdle in its merger with SPAC Armada. The SEC declared its S-4 registration statement effective, setting up a shareholder vote on September 30. If approved, the company will list on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN, giving $XRP a new institutional access point. Reports note a 233 million dollar impairment charge on the firm's books, though structural concerns have not been raised.

In the mining sector, a powerful rebound played out. Bitcoin's advance from roughly 62,000 to 80,000 dollars supercharged equity exposure. Canaan, American Bitcoin, and Cango posted gains of up to 67% over the quarter, according to Cointelegraph. The 23% move higher in $BTC lifted mining stocks out of a long stretch of underperformance versus AI-linked peers, reinforcing that direct BTC exposure remains a primary lever for the industry. Options expiry data shows 6.4 billion dollars in contracts cleared around the 80,000 dollar level, with traders rebuilding positioning at a noticeably higher range.

On the security front, The Sandbox announced it will fully compensate users for a 700,000 dollar bridge exploit, pledging 1:1 repayment from its treasury. Eligible holders on Base and BNB Chain will receive Ethereum-based SAND, with claims expected to open within two weeks. Separately, OneKey disclosed that it reproduced a transaction replacement attack against an older version of the Ledger Ethereum app in a controlled lab environment. Ledger reportedly patched the flaw in Ethereum app 1.22.2 and no user funds were affected. The episode highlights how critical it is for hardware wallet users to keep firmware and companion apps current.

The macro calendar is also drawing attention. Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks are being closely watched for signals on Fed policy and Treasury repurchase operations, with direct implications for long-end US yields, gold, and risk assets including Bitcoin. Markets responded modestly: $ETH and SOL posted minor gains in 24 hours, while $BTC consolidated just below 80,000 dollars after the options expiry flush. Trading volumes across major venues ticked up, indicating fresh engagement rather than thin holiday conditions.

Speaking at Bitcoin Asia 2026, Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao said Bitcoin could surpass gold in the next high-volatility cycle and that stablecoins are positioned to lead AI-driven payment integration. Taken together, the Evernorth listing path, the mining equity rebound, the resolution of the Sandbox incident, and the Jackson Hole backdrop frame a market digest that bridges institutional plumbing, security discipline, and macro inflection in a single session.
